dedupe_keys.name: opozorilna karta verjetnosti pojavljanja zemeljskih in hribinskih plazov

description: Opozorilna karta verjetnosti pojavljanja zemeljskih in hribinskih plazov is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VODE. Warning map data is used for the purpose of defining the need to produce more detailed analyses to give an opinion on the threat from landslides and mountainous landslides in a specific area. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VODE. The portal shows the English title as "Warning map of the likelihood of landslides and mountainous landslides occurring" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VODE. Its keywords include Območja nevarnosti naravnih nesreč, plaz, analiza naravnega tveganja. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
